title: Canonical localization charts for a truncated graded section module
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x_0,x_1] with standard grading and P=Proj S [def-sc-p1-standard], and let G be coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. Let M be an S-module with an internal Z-grading M_z, homogeneous multiplication S_e M_z contained in M_(e+z), and M_z=0 for z<0. Suppose additive equivalences phi_z:M_z -> Gamma(P,G tensor O_P(z)) for z>=0 commute with multiplication by every homogeneous a in S_e, using G tensor twistMul(z,a) on sections [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. Then there are additive injections alpha_(f,d):Gamma(D+(f),G) -> M_f for every homogeneous f of degree d>0, whose image is the degree-zero fractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions]. They respect the S_(f) action via awayToSection, and for every inclusion D+(g) contained in D+(f) and relation g^e=a*f with e>0 and homogeneous a, restriction carries any fraction y/f^m to a^m*y/g^(e*m). No finite generation of M is asserted or assumed.

source.place: Proposition 0BXD, final paragraph of the proof; canonical comparison for the nonnegative section module

proof.text: For each homogeneous f of positive degree d, multiplication by f^r gives an isomorphism G|D+(f) to G(r*d)|D+(f): use twistRestrictIso, unitIsoTwistZero, and tensor with G. For y in M_(r*d), send y/f^r to the inverse image of the restriction of phi_(r*d)(y). If f=0 then D+(f) is empty and the localization is zero, and the construction is the unique zero map. Otherwise a homogeneous representative with denominator f^r has degree r*d, since a nonzero homogeneous polynomial has a unique degree. Equality of fractions is the relation LocalizedModule.mk_eq. Clear denominators to compare two numerators in a common degree, and use hphi and the inverse multiplication maps. This proves independence and additivity; a difference maps to zero precisely when its corresponding twisted section restricts to zero. The second clause of lem-sc-p1-serre-section-module-comparison kills it by a power of f; hphi translates this to the localization relation. The first clause supplies every section. Thus the map is an additive bijection from the degree-zero fractions to the chart sections; invert it and compose with the inclusion into the ordinary localization.

For a scalar homogeneous fraction b/f^l and a module fraction y/f^r, the product is (b*y)/f^(l+r), by LocalizedModule.mk_smul_mk. The compatibility of phi with b says its twisted section is multiplication by b of the section for y. On D+(f), invert multiplication by f^(l+r), giving exactly the action of b/f^l on the inverse image of y/f^r. Every homogeneous-localization scalar has such a representative, so this proves the scalar formula for the inverse additive chart map.

For g^e=a*f and any representative y/f^m, first use a homogeneous equal-degree representative to compute the restriction as (a^m*y)/g^(e*m). Indeed compatibility with a^m identifies its numerator section, while a^m*f^m=g^(e*m), so both sides give the same section after the invertible multiplication by g^(e*m). For an arbitrary y/f^m representing the same degree-zero fraction, LocalizedModule.mk_eq says a power of f kills the difference after denominators are cleared. Multiplication by the corresponding power of a converts this equality into one killed by a power of g, since g^e=a*f. Thus the same formula holds for every representative, including nonhomogeneous numerators. This is the restriction identity asserted in the conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 0BXD, final paragraph; fraction formulas expanded by H1

theorem serreSectionModuleCharts
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (G : (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Modules)
    (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent
      (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).toRingedSpace G)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))
    (𝓜 : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (h𝓜 : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓜)
    (hsmul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ℤ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (y : M),
      a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → y ∈ 𝓜 z → a • y ∈ 𝓜 (n + z))
    (hneg : ∀ z : ℤ, z < 0 → 𝓜 z = ⊥)
    (φ : ∀ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z →
        (𝓜 z ≃+ Γ(G ⊗ Proj.twist (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) z, ⊤)))
    (hφ : ∀ (z : ℤ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (e : ℕ) (hze : 0 ≤ z + e) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)
        (ha : a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k e)
        (y : 𝓜 z) (hay : a • (y : M) ∈ 𝓜 (z + e)),
        φ (z + e) hze ⟨a • (y : M), hay⟩ =
          Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (G ◁ Proj.twistMul z ha) ⊤ (φ z hz y)) :
    ∃ (alpha : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ),
      0 < d → f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d →
      G.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)) →+
        LocalizedModule.Away f M),
      (∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d),
        Function.Injective (alpha f d hd hf) ∧
        Set.range (alpha f d hd hf) = degreeZeroFractions
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝓜 n : Set M)) (Submonoid.powers f)) ∧
      (∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (r : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (s : G.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
        alpha f d hd hf (awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f r • s) =
          algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
            (Localization.Away f) r • alpha f d hd hf s) ∧
      (∀ (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d b : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hb : 0 < b)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (hg : g ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k b)
        (inc : basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) g ≤
          basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (e c : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
        0 < e → a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k c → g ^ e = a * f →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : M)
          (s : G.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
          alpha f d hd hf s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
          alpha g b hb hg (G.val.map (homOfLE inc).op s) =
            mk (a ^ m • y) (⟨g ^ (e * m), ⟨e * m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers g))
